mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT check_date FROM study_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY check_date DESC

SELECT check_date AS checkDate, IFNULL(SUM(duration_minutes), 0) AS totalMinutes, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(mood ORDER BY id DESC), ',', 1) AS mood, MAX(id) AS checkinId FROM study_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(check_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY check_date ORDER BY check_date ASC
